newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha trims loss with crude, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha trims loss with crude, trade quiet.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices trimmed their losses on Tuesday after crude rallied, but they still ended slightly lower in quiet physical trading.
Traders blamed the slight drop on a correction to last week's gains and lightened arbitrage interest after about 100,000 to 150,000 tonnes were fixed to the U.S. last week.
But prices were still supported by an attractive looking arbitrage across the Atlantic and because Algeria's Skikda port closed again on Tuesday due to bad weather.
A 58,000 tonne cargo was fixed out of Skikda for the U.S. Gulf Coast for loading Dec 12, shipping sources said.
Traders said high freight rates in the Med sparked rumors that cargoes were being loaded together for early December out of Skikda.
Dec swaps ended down $2 at $222.50/$223.50, with Jan swpas at a $9 backwardation at $213.50/$214.50. Feb swaps fell $4 to $205.50/$206.50.
